info.title: ParseForMe API
info.description: Upload a document, get structured data back. Authenticate with a workspace API key as `Authorization: Bearer pfm_live_…`. Rate limits are per API key: 60 requests/minute, 10 document creations/minute and 500/day. Over a limit the API answers 429 with `Retry-After` and the `RateLimit` / `RateLimit-Policy` fields — honour them. Webhook deliveries and `sourceUrl` fetches originate from 46.62.162.196.
